oracleRisk.summary: YUSD has no borrower liquidation branches. Both native AegisMinting deployments use Chainlink collateral USD prices and a configured Aegis YUSD/USD oracle to bound redemption collateral amounts. SETTINGS_MANAGER_ROLE can replace the Aegis oracle, whose operator can directly set the YUSD/USD price and whose owner can appoint operators. Ethereum block 26097119 and BSC block 125091227 on 2026-10-01 confirm nonzero configured oracle addresses. This is discretionary top-level price authority, not automatic balance-derived share accounting.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Aegis's YUSD strategy uses BTC spot collateral and COIN-M perpetuals whose hedge and reserve operations depend on BTC spot/perpetual marks to keep the dollar value stable. This is a price-sensitive top-level internal strategy authority, not a borrower liquidation branch; YUSD has no borrower-owned debt or collateral liquidation paths, so the disposition is top-level-only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum and BSC native YUSD use chain-local AegisMinting and burn/mint OFT adapters; Avalanche and Katana retain their earlier LayerZero route reviews. The expanded issuer deployment census registers Arbitrum, Base, Monad, Plasma, Starknet, and Hedera, including deployed zero-supply tokens. Arbitrum/Base verified YUSDOFT source and Plasma's immutable-masked runtime match prove direct burn/mint without canonical escrow. Starknet's verified mint/burn adapter source and pinned token/role bindings likewise prove direct burn/mint. MonadScan exposes an exact-match verified YUSDOFT compilation proving direct burn/mint, and pinned Monad owner/quorum reads identify the local 3-of-5 Safe. The scoped 2026-10-11 Hedera follow-up successfully pins owner, token, endpoint and supply through the public Mirror helper, but pinned bytecode remains unsupported and the route remains unresolved. Whole-asset independent-liability eligibility remains withdrawn; the historical route/escrow/in-flight census is not established, and neither older controls nor Katana source-provenance limits are refreshed by the scoped Hedera research.
